flavour: Gesturing lazily with a crooked staff, the caster enchances and sharpens the minds of those nearby, giving them a clearer look upon a world.
effect: Remains in play. Whilst this spell is in play, friendly units within the Command range of this model may re-roll any failed Stupidy tests. Additionally, if a friendly unit within the Command range of this model when this spell is cast failed its Stupidy test during the Start of Turn sub-phase of the same turn, it may immediately make this test again.

flavour: Spitting a guttural incantation, the caster launches a ball of sickly green and yellow Troll vomit toward the enemy, scorching flesh and dissolving armour.
effect: Place a small (3”) blast template so that its central hole is directly over the centre of the target enemy unit. Once placed, the template will scatter D3+1”. Any enemy model whose base lies underneath the template’s final position risks being hit (as described on page 95 of the Warhammer: the Old World rulebook) and suffering a Strenght 3 hit with an AP of -2.

flavour: Under the beguiling influence of this crude magic, even the most experienced warriors can quicly find themselves hopelessly confused and at a loss for what to do.
effect: Remains in Play. Whilst this spell is in play, the target enemy unit becomes subject to the Stupidity special rule and reduces their Leadership characteristic by 1.

flavour: Through arcane means or by simply being reminded how hungry they are, the assembled Trolls face forward with a sudden burst of vigour.
effect: Until the end of this turn, all friendly units that have the Stupidity special rule and are within 12” of the caster gain a +2 modifier to their Movement characteristic.

flavour: A deluge of foul swamp water and unmentionable waste is spun into swirling tornado and unleashed onto a battlefield.
effect: Remains in Play. Place a small (3”) blast template so that its central hole is within 18” of the caster. Whilst in play, the template is treated as difficult terrain. The template scatters D6” during every Start of Turn sub-phase. Any enemy unit that moves through the template, or that the template moves over, suffers D3+3 Strength 4 hits, each with an AP of -3.

flavour: With an almighty belch, the caster heaves a stream of burning bile across their foes as the battlelines clash.
effect: Place a flame template so that the narrow end touches the caster’s base edge and the broad end is over a unit they are engaged in combat with. Any model (friend or foe) whole base lies undearneath the template risks being hit and suffering a single Strength 3 hit with an AP of -2.

flavour: Drawning on the regenerative properties of the Trolls, the caster channels that enchanced healing towards those in harm’s way.
effect: Until the end of your next Start of Turn sub-phase, the target friendly unit gains the Flammable and Regeneration (5+) special rules.
